headline: Qualcomm buys AI software firm Modular for ~$3.9B
body: A quiet day with one deal. Qualcomm confirmed it is buying AI software company Modular for about $3.9 billion to strengthen its chip software. Another acquisition adds to Power Concentration, which lifts Enslaved God and Benevolent Dictator and trims Libertarian Utopia. Horizon Balance: +0.78.
movers_note: Libertarian Utopia -0.1, Enslaved God +0.1 and Benevolent Dictator +0.1, all from the Qualcomm-Modular deal.
coming_up: Qualcomm-Modular deal expected to close in H2 2026
